scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

measurement.scope:
Frozen full-period diagnostic: actual 1000-flow batch scoring, no adaptation.

NF-v3 was inspected previously; this expands development evaluation to every
flow in the final chronological period and is not independent confirmation.
caveats: One seed, two fixed models, four fixed policies. Context extraction uses all past unlabelled flows.
Batch time includes history extraction, two model predictions, four threshold policies and metric bookkeeping; CSV parsing is separate.
This batch benchmark does not measure network transport, queue waiting, alert delivery or Raspberry Pi performance.
